facts.name: model_heading
facts.value: SD6200 — 4U 90 HDD Dense Storage SAS-4 Expansion System

facts.name: drive_and_power_scope
facts.value: Up to 90 12G SAS or 6G SATA 3.5-inch or 2.5-inch drives; 13 W maximum drive power at 35 C.

facts.name: esm_configuration
facts.value: Dual redundant hot-swappable ESMs; single ESM configuration supported; ESM = Expansion SAS Module.

facts.name: esm_ports
facts.value: Four 24G SAS4-capable mini-SAS HD ports per ESM; one RJ45 management port; one UART via 3.5 mm jack.

facts.name: psu_redundancy_as_printed
facts.value: 1300W 80 plus Platinum PSU, 2+2 (200-240V) or 3+1 (100-240V) redundant, hot swap.

facts.name: input_voltage_as_printed
facts.value: 100-127,200-240V AC input, auto ranging, 47~63Hz. These are printed separated voltage bands, not silently a continuous 100-240 V range.

facts.name: fan_description
facts.value: 5 x 80 mm dual-rotor fans, hot-pluggable from the top.

facts.name: dimensions
facts.value: Height 175.3 mm (6.9 in), width 448 mm (17.64 in), depth 1070 mm (42.12 in) w/CMA.

facts.name: environmental_conditions
facts.value: Operating 5 C to 35 C; non-operating -40 C to 60 C; humidity 8% to 80% RH; altitude 0 to 950 m, de-rate temperature 1 C per 300 m above 950 m.

facts.name: sound_power_as_printed
facts.value: At (23+/-2 C), sound power <7.6 Bel; do not re-label as sound pressure or listening-position noise.

facts.name: revision_and_heading_conflict
facts.value: Copyright Celestica Inc. 2024; literal token 091024. Footer calls DS6200 a trademark although both headings say SD6200; no alias inferred.

absences: No full chassis ordering/SKU table, exact PSU manufacturer/model or weight supplied.

conflicts: Redundancy line 3+1 (100-240V) differs in range expression from input line 100-127,200-240V; preserve both.
DS6200 trademark footer differs from SD6200 headings.

facts.name: psu_and_input
facts.value: 2 redundant, load-sharing, hot-swappable AC or -54 VDC PSUs; input voltage 120 to 240 VAC at 50-60 Hz and 40 to 72 VDC, as separately printed.

facts.name: power_input_option
facts.value: Separate power input option: 12 VDC; not merged into the -54 VDC PSU line or assumed wired the same way.

facts.name: typical_power_consumption
facts.value: Typical power consumption 436 W, document statement with no test/load condition supplied in this section; not PSU output or maximum draw.

facts.name: dimensions_and_weight
facts.value: Dimensions W x D x H: 44 x 50.7 x 4.4 cm (17.32 x 19.97 x 1.732 in); weight 8.8 kg (19.56 lb).

facts.name: fan_airflow
facts.value: 4+1 redundant, hot-swappable fans; front (port) to back (power) airflow direction.

facts.name: environmental
facts.value: Operating temperature 0 C to 45 C; storage -40 C to 70 C; operating/storage humidity 10% to 90% non-condensing.

facts.name: software_as_printed
facts.value: Switch is loaded with OpenBMC and Diagnostics. Listed compatibility: FBOSS Agent, Open Network Linux, SnapRoute FlexSwitch, Cumulus Linux 3.4 and later. Historical vendor statements, not current support or installed software on an auction unit.

facts.name: revision
facts.value: Ordering-page footer EC-DS-0617-04; page-2 copyright 2016. Download filename R04 and uploaded path 2024/01 are not revision/publication dates by themselves.
